sloka: शतमोघसहस्राणाम् महौघ इति विश्रुतः ।एवम् कोटि सहस्रेण शन्कूनाम् च शतेन च ॥६-२८-३९॥।।
transliteration: śatamoghasahasrāṇām mahaugha iti viśrutaḥ ।evam koṭi sahasreṇa śankūnām ca śatena ca ॥6-28-39॥।।

translations.english: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.
